# Equal-budget LSTM on the test period (single run) (generated by `scripts/run_test_lstm_stage3.py`)

Git commit `ff6bbab6be`. L4_full_A LSTM with the configuration selected on validation among 90 trials per horizon (`reports/lstm_stage3.md`), fitted on the training period only, epochs fixed from validation, 3 seeds, mean prediction. The original frozen LSTM L4 and XGBoost S4 are taken from the saved predictions of the frozen test run.
